Quick note from finance at Helix — we're in the middle of a short receivables lag tied to a customer milestone push and need to request a temporary extension on our Redwood invoices for the next two billing cycles. - We need invoices to show VAT pass-through to our EU acquisitions entity (EU Acquisitions Ltd) — VAT number provided below.
- We will raise PO-23891 (attached) and can provide the PO now; timely acceptance will trigger payment approvals on our side.

Hi Elliot — thanks for the context and the forecast. I understand the temporary pressure and we want to help keep things running while balancing risk on our side. A few practical options I can propose quickly:

1) Conditional Net45 for two cycles (April & May) with a hard credit cap and a signed amendment — no change to our baseline Net30 after that period.
2) Staged invoice split: 60% invoice at invoice date / 40% due on net45 — with invoices routed to your EU entity for VAT purposes.
3) Interim Net30 + 25% prepayment hold (applied to invoices) while we complete a credit review — fastest to approve but requires limited prepay.

What we'll need from you to expedite:
- Signed PO (PO-23891) confirmed in the email
- VAT certificate/screenshot for EU Acquisitions Ltd
- Confirmation of requested credit cap (what limit would be sufficient for the two cycles?)

I've attached a quick conditional_terms_v1.pdf that outlines option 1 and 2 (high level) so we have a starting point. I'll loop in Marcus in finance to scope the credit cap and Neha on collections for routing. If agreeable, we can send a short amendment via DocuSign today.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
